findings.text: The four accepted receipts record instrument_sha256 6936d5e39b5bf02cd19e1275afbb1483114225989a3f9f650dc51e8448a63fa6, which matches no committed revision of measure.py (4c87b30ae hashes d747c0ee, and 391245bdb and d3d17c064 both hash 54189df4), while the rejected pilot at full-control.json records c7353edb, which is exactly commit 93daf68f2's file; so the field is reliable and the accepted table was produced by an uncommitted instrument, which leaves the committed h200.sh/run.sh a different program from the one behind the published stage table a follow-on node will be dispatched against.

counts() restates the same optimized-HLO, StableHLO, fusion and while counting already written at scripts/prototypes/bank_booking_cost/measure.py:67-79, adding only custom_call_sites, so a later change to how lowered programs are counted must be made twice.

owner() re-derives source-frame attribution that scripts/prototypes/order2/attribution.py:10-27 _source_owner already owns, reading traceback.frames and frame.function_name where that owner uses raw_frames and code.co_name; the stage precedence lattice is genuinely new but the frame extraction is a second spelling of an existing mechanism.

The brief asks the split to cover cut-cell clipping and quadrature and the topology and connectivity decision each as its own stage; the fragment discloses at line 9 that on the full read both are timed jointly inside support_read._rebuilt_reading, so that enumerated coverage is met only for the carried arm and the full read's 5915 ms leading stage is not decomposed.

The gate log's header names revision 309e86e6ba35599440e3e082cf158bb53c2ff2cd, whose report.py uses a logarithmic axis and cannot emit the committed linear-panel SVG or the committed fragment, so the log does not identify the revision its artifacts came from; only the appended COMMITTED_REPORT_SHA256=a8f7a305 line at log line 12 ties the executed report.py to d3d17c064.

item_verdicts.call_sites: No production module imports or dispatches the harness; grep over nova/, scripts/, apps/ and tests/ finds no reference to bank_read_attribution outside its own directory, so the harness is reached by no runtime path and only reaches product code inward through inspect.getsource and unittest.mock.patch.
item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against 7ca1b11a: f6d8b06df adds measure.py, run.sh and h200.sh; 3eff6396d, 93daf68f2, 4c87b30ae and 391245bdb refine the owner partition and common-expression sharing in measure.py; 309e86e6b adds report.py; d3d17c064 swaps the log axis for two linear panels and adds the fragment and SVG.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when's three clauses are asserted by scripts/prototypes/bank_read_attribution/report.py:298-301 (coverage through measure.py:18-21), :320-330 and :386 (two-process spread) and :461-516 (fragment plus checked SVG), and the recorded gate at artifact-gate.log:6 reports maximum_coverage_gap_percent 7.248 and maximum_native_spread_percent 1.081 with EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to attribute the bank read cost to its stages and rank the read-cost changes that follow; scripts/prototypes/bank_read_attribution/measure.py:58-104 names ten owning stages and report.py:47-100 emits three ranked proposals, though the full read times cut-cell clipping and connectivity jointly inside support_read._rebuilt_reading rather than separately as the brief enumerates.
item_verdicts.manifest: The manifest reports status complete, all seven commits, the report.py gate command and its artifact-gate.log, max_abs_coverage_percent 7.2483234047782785 and max_native_process_spread_percent 1.0806736575320672, and its numbers reconcile against geometry/summary.json and the four receipts.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares three roots (scripts/prototypes/bank_read_attribution, the evidence fragment and the figure directory); git diff --stat 7ca1b11a..d3d17c064 lists exactly six added files and every one is inside them, with no product source in the diff.

justifications.durability: measure.py:32 and :422 fail loudly if the anchored product branch is refactored or the region chain diverges from native, and measure.py:480-494 plus report.py:394-402 require the omission control to be refused.
justifications.evidence: artifact-gate.log:6 records the coverage and spread results the done_when asks for and report.py:298-301 re-derives them from the receipts, yet the receipts' own instrument_sha256 at geometry/full-1.json matches no committed revision of measure.py.
justifications.fit: measure.py, report.py, run.sh and h200.sh mirror the scripts/prototypes/<topic>/{measure,report,run} layout of bank_booking_cost and bank_solve_profile, reuse their machine() and save_checked() helpers, and carry conventional subjects with bodies and no plan or ticket identifiers.
justifications.goal_fidelity: measure.py:58-104 attributes booking, the stationary solve, wall contact, clipping, connectivity, qualification and field contraction, but report.py:41-45 shows the full arm's clipping and connectivity folded into support_read._rebuilt_reading rather than separately timed.
justifications.reuse: report.py:270 and measure.py:278 reuse bank_solve_profile/plot.py:save_checked and bank_newton_step/measure.py:machine, but measure.py:249-257 restates the five-metric lowered-count block already written at bank_booking_cost/measure.py:67-79.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 7ca1b11a36f16779d583edb6ddbfb264218d24cb d3d17c064bd10c209aa4adec67c0ce9e5d1a3785 lists six files, all inside the manifest's three declared write roots, and no nova/ product source appears.
